how-30-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the skull, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-30-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the skull, then tap three things you notice.

how-30-01-compare.page: Put the green leaf under one tray and the pale sand under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-30-01-compare.say: Put the green leaf under one tray and the pale sand under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-30-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-30-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-30-01-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap an adaptation you see, then name its animal group. Predict where it lives, and watch its habitat appear.
how-30-01-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap an adaptation you see, then name its animal group. Predict where it lives, and watch its habitat appear.

how-30-01-partc.page: Pick any Florida animal from this lesson. Draw it in its habitat and label two adaptations. For each label, name the feature and how it helps.
how-30-01-partc.say: Pick any Florida animal from this lesson. Draw it in its habitat and label two adaptations. For each label, name the feature and how it helps.
